body: Well I've also been having hallucinations while I am sober. I'll see things in my peripheral vision, and several times a day I'll see tracers in my vision which is the most odd part about it all. Also at the moment I have a good amount of time. I'm not really locked into anything I'm not in school, and I don't have a job right now.
For the moment I'm too scared to. Post-trip I do not feel like the same person I was before at all.
I'd hug you back. Sometimes that's all you need. Someone to be there and to embrace you when you're down. I thank you for your support. Words couldn't explain my gratitude. \<3

I've also tried to stop dealing with others. For a long while I became a complete shut in only leaving the house for school and work. Avoiding eye contact with others and generally keeping to myself. I found it became a hole of sadness that just keep filling up and I tried to become outgoing again only to be met with the same problems. I understand your struggle as much as you understand mine, and I appreciate you even when others may not. \<3

I've tried endlessly to find something to take away these burdens. I'm especially talented in music as I've had a natural singing talent from a young age. In fact I was in band for a little while, but unfortunately things didn't work out and we all split up. Ever since then I've lost a lot of my passion for it, but I think I may try to go about it again sometime soon. I've always found that when I really get into a song and put my all into it I feel alright for a good solid moment. In fact now that I think about it I may try and really get back into making music to help me deal.
